engine.name: Tetrad
engine.preferred_decision: Integrate a pinned Java process for a narrow PC/Fisher-Z path; do not port the engine or infer qualification from its version name. FGES is a separately configurable next path, not initially admitted.

scope.initial_method: PC with a reviewed failure-transparent Fisher-Z wrapper
scope.data: Finite complete continuous observations, one independent unit per row, an explicitly declared IID linear Gaussian regime, no weights or repeated clusters.
scope.assumption_status: Caller assumptions remain unverified; data syntax and successful search cannot certify them.
scope.initial_knowledge: Empty background knowledge. Temporal/required/forbidden edges require a reviewed constrained-PDAG contract, not a relabeling of an observational CPDAG.
scope.initial_search: No user conditioning-depth cap: setDepth(-1). A resource limit may interrupt the job, but cannot yield an accepted partial graph.
scope.result: Estimated CPDAG with explicit endpoint marks and no edge-confidence or whole-graph-coverage claim, admitted only after independent graph-class validation.
not_admitted: bounded-depth graph advertised as a completed CPDAG

shared_contract.availability: Proposed adapter surfaces only; do not advertise them as implemented or installed.
shared_contract.context_extension: This adapter requires the inherited complete scientific_context even though the generic contract's required_for list does not include graph.discover. Its downstream scalar target is retained as context and is not computed. Standalone discovery without that target needs a separately reviewed context schema; never invent a treatment or outcome.
shared_contract.data_boundary: Resolve authorized immutable input handles, verify bytes/schema/hash and pass only those data to the configured local Java process. No caller-supplied executable, arbitrary filesystem path or network URL.

request_preservation.digest: Use inherited context_digest for the entire context and a separate request digest including engine commit, adapter version, artifact hashes, all algorithm/numerical settings and resource limits. A reused key with changed content is rejected.
request_preservation.estimand: Keep population, treatment/control ordering, outcome, horizon and sign exactly. Discovery computes no contrast; estimate, coordinate_sets and uncertainty are null. A discovery success is not an identified-effect response.
request_preservation.coordinates: Map opaque external variable IDs bijectively to V0000, V0001,... in sorted external-ID order. Store original data column order and the full permutation. Preserve labels, units, time indices, measurement and availability times in a sidecar; include every isolated node.
request_preservation.units: Data arrive in declared original units. Record any centering/standardization constants and invertible scale map in the result evidence. Graph adjacency is unitless; no numerical effect or currency conversion is inferred from it.
request_preservation.sampling: Retain sampling.law, independent-unit ID, population, inclusion and any selection statement verbatim. Reject declared clusters, repeat observations, weights, time-series dependence or unknown sampling law in this initial route; do not set effective n to row count to conceal dependence.
request_preservation.clocks: Retain decision, measurement, availability and outcome horizons even though this route does not use temporal knowledge to orient edges. No post-action column becomes a baseline by renaming it.
request_preservation.graph_input: Discovery does not take an asserted graph as truth or silently use it as an initial graph. Retain any proposed graph as evidence context only; reject a request demanding its required directions in the initial empty-knowledge route.

required_checks: Explicit alpha with0<alpha<1; all scientific/numerical parameters recognized and finite.
At least two distinct variables; unique variable IDs; exact correspondence between metadata and matrix columns; numeric finite data with no missing values.
n>=p+2 so the maximal conditioning set has positive Fisher-Z degrees of freedom; this is a necessary arithmetic check, not a power guarantee.
No constant/duplicate/accounting-linearly-dependent columns under a declared numerical rank/conditioning policy. A failed rank check is a data/model representation error, not dependence evidence.
Declared complete IID Gaussian scope, no hidden-variable/selection request, no background constraints or user depth cap.
Resolved environment, license/distribution scope, complete failure audit and graph-class validator have admission receipts before engine dispatch.
preflight.failure_action: Reject malformed inputs; use a completed unsupported/unavailable disposition for scientifically valid requests outside the route. Give the exact failed condition and a reviewable alternative without silently repairing the scientific question.

dispatch.constructor: Create a new data object, test wrapper and Pc object per job; never reconfigure a test during parallel calls.
settings: Pc.setVerbose(false); bounded diagnostic log separated from the result channel
dispatch.fisher_z: Use the explicit complete-data/FAIL missing policy. The proposed IndependenceTest wrapper calls the inspected getResult path, records each query and its completion/failure, and derives independence only from a valid returned statistic. It does not use checkIndependence's singular-matrix-to-p0 branch.
dispatch.numerical_profile: Set shrinkageMode=NONE, ridge=0 and usePseudoinverse=false explicitly before search; retain pinvTolerance even though inactive. Set effective sample size to the verified complete row count only within the declared IID regime. Keep the legacy lambda parameter at0, documented as a no-op. Regularized or pseudoinverse tests need their own calibration profile and cannot silently rescue a failed inversion.
dispatch.wrapper_prerequisite: The Java IndependenceTest interface and all methods used by FAS/PC must be acquired, inspected, implemented and compiled before admission. This design does not claim that wrapping getResult alone fulfills the interface.
dispatch.failure_transparency: Every invocation has a unique query ID and terminal record. Record singularity, nonfinite statistic, abs(r)>=1 or insufficient df as invalid for this initial regular regime. Set a shared job failure latch before propagating any exception. No completed graph can publish if a call failed, was interrupted or lacks a terminal record, even if an engine path catches an exception.
dispatch.parallelism: FAS stable source uses parallelStream; do not infer concurrency from FGES's separate numThreads field. Pin and measure the JVM/common-pool configuration, use thread-safe query records and perform deterministic oracle comparisons before claiming repeatability.
dispatch.timeout: Parent process enforces the whole-job wall/memory/output budget. Pc's timeout setting is supplementary: the inspected skeleton dispatch does not demonstrate a whole-process deadline guarantee. On timeout/cancellation retain diagnostics privately and withhold the graph.
dispatch.fg_es_future: A separate FGES/SemBicScore profile must bind its penalty, score missingness policy, search settings and worker count, then pass its own failure, equivalence and sampling checks. It cannot inherit PC admission.

graph_conversion.wire_form: Keep all node IDs and each unordered pair's two endpoint marks; node sorting swaps marks with the nodes. Do not emit only a0/1 adjacency matrix.
graph_conversion.marks: Tetrad tail-arrow at(left,right) maps left->right; arrow-tail maps right->left; tail-tail remains unoriented. Circle or arrow-arrow is an unexpected endpoint in this initial CPDAG route and returns an invalid-engine-output failure with raw diagnostic preserved.
graph_conversion.validation: Check node identity, self/duplicate edges, allowed endpoint pairs, directed cycles, and independently recognize a completed PDAG representing a Markov class. Syntax-only reference checks are insufficient. The full validator is a later implementation prerequisite.
graph_conversion.equivalence: Keep the full CPDAG. Do not choose one consistent DAG, count its directed arrows as identified directions, or equate a stable adjacency with an edge probability. Any later graph-set enumeration carries every member and its coordinate map.
graph_conversion.coefficients: No coefficient matrix is returned by the PC route. A later weighted route must declare source-row versus target-row layout, retain signs and scales, and preserve the original signed matrix separately. Thresholded graph edges cannot reconstruct coefficients.
graph_conversion.effects: No effect set is computed here. In particular, a later multiset of effects{0,0,2/5} is not a confidence set and cannot be replaced by its convex hull[0,2/5]. Unknown is never encoded as an empty set or zero effect.

response.computed: status=completed, disposition=computed, result.kind=graph; graph artifact and sidecar identities present; estimate=null, coordinate_sets=null, uncertainty=null; qualification at most execution_only without stronger exact evidence.
response.unavailable: Before runtime admission return completed/unavailable with result=null and missing prerequisites in evidence. No engine invocation is claimed.
response.unsupported: Return completed/unsupported with result=null, preserved context digest, specific scientific condition and alternative route. Never use not_identified to mean that a discovery engine cannot handle a request.
response.failed: Malformed input: rejected/refused with error and null result. Numerical/runtime/output failure: failed/unavailable with typed error, failure evidence and null result. Retain input/request identity and attempted settings.
response.uncertainty: Alpha is the CI-test setting. No graph confidence or effect uncertainty is produced. Graph-class validity is a structural property, not proof the true graph is in that class.
response.transport_parity: Library, CLI and MCP carry the same canonical request/result and evidence digests. MCP progress notifications or CLI exit success never promote scientific qualification.

unsupported_catalog.alternative: Choose a separately reviewed temporal/cluster discovery profile; preserve unit and calendar structure.
Review FCI/PAG or an explicit selection model with separate source and admission evidence.
Specify and review the observation/missingness mechanism and a dedicated correction route; do not silently delete or impute.
Use a reviewed constrained-PDAG/MPDAG representation preserving the knowledge provenance.
Review accounting identities, variable definitions or sampling design; retaining an edge is not a repair.
Send a supplied model/class to a separately qualified identification operation; retain ambiguity.
Complete the declared prototype admission experiments; continue proposal work without claiming runtime availability.

deployment.boundary: Proposed local child Java process with a fixed executable/configuration, bounded request and framed result channel, separated stderr, immutable input and result handles. No sibling repository modifications or external publication.
deployment.environment_lock: Record Java vendor/version, compiler target, Maven dependency graph and artifact hashes, OS/architecture, native libraries, adapter commit, runtime flags and core allocation. Resolve source POM release21 versus bridge README25+ for the actual route; do not guess from either alone.
deployment.license: Record GPLv3 root text and source-header v3-or-later notices. Review the actual distribution/linkage arrangement; a subprocess boundary is not a blanket exemption from license obligations.
deployment.publication: Parent validates completed job, all-query terminal records, graph class and byte digests before atomic result publication. A late cancellation reports the observed terminal state; it cannot undo a published immutable result.
deployment.recovery: No mid-search resume promised. A pre-publication crash retains a failed attempt and may restart the same immutable job with a new attempt ID. Idempotent completed publication returns the same result; a changed request needs a new job. Attempts remain in all-request denominators.

required_admission_examples: Independent Gaussian chain CPDAG with exactly three consistent DAGs and effect multiset{0,0,2/5}; keep the class and no fabricated effect interval.
Collider oracle, isolated node and explicit variable permutations; endpoint roundtrip including reversed left/right representation.
Six-variable conditioning counterexample from the Java survey; depth3 separator and added-collider dependence remain distinct.
Funding signed matrix: original cost response-3/50, transposed0, absolute-weight13/50; distinguish layout, units and graph-only outputs.
Singular/near-singular covariance, insufficient df, missing values and declared cluster sampling return explicit failures or unsupported results.
Injected CI exception/interruption must set the failure latch even if downstream search returns; no success artifact is published.
Parent timeout, cancellation/publication race, process crash and bounded output behavior with every attempt retained.
Matched library/CLI/MCP scientific digests and mutation refusals; no external consumer qualification inferred.
Only after deterministic conformance: registered generated-sample calibration and resource study with fixed budgets, failures and competing baselines.
review_limits: A complete proposal contract does not imply a compiled adapter, available endpoints, accepted statistical calibration or product deployment.
Independent reference arithmetic and codec examples are design evidence only; they do not execute Tetrad.
Full Java ecosystem coverage can remain open while this narrow design advances.
Real bank experiments remain conditional after a justified prototype; none is required to write or review this design.
